INV="$SCR/inv.txt"; printf '%s\n' \
  skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md \
  skills/implement/phases/pha …[per-command-truncated]

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1642/local/wt/skills/implement/phases
git show 6b6369e5:lib/test/lint-worktree-fence-shapes.py > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1642/local/wt/lint.py

echo "=== root .gitignore .prflow entries ==="; grep -nE 'prflow|devflow' .gitignore 2>/dev/null
echo "=== .prflow/.gitignore (scoped) ==="; cat .prflow/.gitignore 2>/dev/null || echo "(absent)"

echo "=== check-ignore root vs subdir ==="; mkdir -p sub/deep 2>/dev/null; git check-ignore -v .prflow/tmp/x.md 2>/dev/null || echo "root .prflow/tmp/x.md NOT ignored"; git check-ignore -v sub/deep/.prflow/tmp/x.md 2>/dev/null …[per-command-truncated]
